component.name: BearWave
component.summary: Desktop internet radio player for Linux

description.p: BearWave is a Qt 6 desktop internet radio player with station browsing, playback controls, favorites, resume support, MPRIS, and tray integration.
This community package installs BearWave's unmodified official Linux release from GitHub at install time.
Initial FlatPark package using the official BearWave Linux runtime payload.
